description: Export your listening history (recently played) to a JSON or CSV sidecar by walking /me/player/recently-played with before-cursor pagination. Respects SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP; writes file 0600 and reports path + counts.

after.description: Cursor: only return items played after this timestamp (milliseconds since epoch or ISO string)

before.description: Cursor: only return items played before this timestamp (milliseconds since epoch or ISO string)

max_items.description: Max history items to export (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP)

output_dir.description: Local directory to write into, confined to the output root (default ~/.spotify-mcp/portability, set SPOTIFY_MCP_PORTABILITY_DIR to move it)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: export_listening_history
